title: Multiplayer Procedural Walk Cycle Generator
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a multiplayer procedural walk cycle generator with up to 4 characters walking simultaneously on a ground plane.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 18) looking at origin.
- Add a large ground plane (40x40) with a subtle grid texture or wireframe overlay so motion is visible.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light from (5, 12, 8) with intensity 0.9 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Skybox or background color: dark navy (#0a0a2a).

CHARACTER CONSTRUCTION (procedural stick-figure bipeds):
- Each character is built from simple Three.js primitives: a sphere head, box torso, cylinder limbs (upper leg, lower leg, upper arm, lower arm).
- Characters are colored distinctly: Player 1 = red (#e74c3c), Player 2 = blue (#3498db), Player 3 = green (#2ecc71), Player 4 = orange (#e67e22).
- Initially spawn only Player 1 at position (-6, 0, 0) facing +X direction.
- Each character has a height of approximately 2.5 units.

PROCEDURAL WALK CYCLE:
- Implement a procedural walk cycle using sinusoidal joint rotations. Each character has these animated joints: left hip, right hip, left knee, right knee, left shoulder, right shoulder, left elbow, right elbow.
- Hip joints swing between -0.6 and +0.6 radians, knees between -0.8 and 0.0 radians (only bend backward), shoulders swing opposite to hips (-0.5 to +0.5), elbows between -0.7 and 0.0.
- Walk cycle frequency is controlled by a 'speed' parameter per character (default 1.0). The phase of the cycle is: angle = speed * elapsedTime * 2.0. Left and right limbs are 180 degrees out of phase.
- When walking, the character translates forward at a rate proportional to speed (0.8 * speed units/sec).
- Characters walk in a circular path of radius 6 around the origin by default.

SPEED CONTROL:
- A global speed multiplier slider (range 0.0 to 3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0) in a HUD panel affects ALL characters.
- Each character also has an individual speed factor (default 1.0). Effective speed = globalSpeed * individualSpeed.

INTERACTIONS:
- Button 'Add Character' (id='addCharBtn'): Adds the next character (up to 4 max). Characters spawn at evenly distributed angles around the circular path.
- Button 'Remove Character' (id='removeCharBtn'): Removes the last added character.
- Button 'Toggle Pause' (id='pauseBtn'): Pauses/resumes all animation. When paused, joint angles freeze.
- Keyboard '1','2','3','4': Select the corresponding character (if it exists). Selected character gets a glowing emissive outline or ring beneath it.
- Keyboard 'W'/'S': Increase/decrease the selected character's individual speed by 0.2 (clamp 0.0 to 3.0).
- Keyboard 'R': Reset all characters to default speed 1.0 and reposition evenly on the circle.
- Global speed slider (id='speedSlider') with label showing current value (id='speedLabel').

HUD / UI:
- Top-left panel with dark semi-transparent background showing: character count, selected character index, global speed, and each active character's individual speed.
- The Add/Remove/Pause buttons in a row below the info panel.
- The speed slider below the buttons.

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
Expose and continuously update:
- characterCount: number of active characters (1-4)
- selectedCharacter: index of selected character (0-based, -1 if none)
- globalSpeed: current global speed multiplier
- paused: boolean
- characters: array of objects, each with { individualSpeed: number, positionX: number, positionZ: number, hipAngleLeft: number, hipAngleRight: number, kneeAngleLeft: number, kneeAngleRight: number, pathAngle: number }
- elapsedTime: total unpaused elapsed time in seconds
- cyclePhases: array of current cycle phase values (one per character, in radians)

IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS:
- All joint angles must remain within their defined bounds at ALL times.
- Left and right hip angles must be opposite in sign (within 0.01 tolerance) at any instant.
- Characters must stay on the circular path (distance from origin should be ~6 ± 0.5).
- When paused, elapsedTime must NOT increment and joint angles must NOT change.
- Individual speeds must be clamped to [0.0, 3.0].
- Removing a character must clean up its Three.js objects from the scene.
physics_constraints: Joint angle bounds: hips [-0.6, 0.6], knees [-0.8, 0.0], shoulders [-0.5, 0.5], elbows [-0.7, 0.0]. Left/right limb phase opposition (pi radians apart). Characters constrained to circular path radius 6 ± 0.5. Translation speed proportional to effective speed. Elapsed time frozen when paused.
